page.overview:
Who is Bull Scholar?

The Bull Scholar is a hunchback that walks with a slumbering gait. He wore a calm green robe and a cap with two horns.

General Yin summoned his allies the Bear Mountain Lord and the Bull Scholar after capturing the monk Tang Sanzang and his attendants. The demons ate the two attendants, but were unable to harm Sanzang because of his holiness.
